ultramarines_captain.name: CAPTAIN OF THE ULTRAMARINES
ultramarines_captain.title: Captain Aurelian Varro, 2nd Company
ultramarines_captain.description: A peerless warrior of Macragge with a power sword and a master-crafted bolt pistol. Click him, then click the battlefield to move him.

abilities.name: BOLTSTORM
abilities.description: Unloads a storm of bolt pistol rounds into up to 8 nearby enemies (flyers included).

abilities.name: RALLY THE BROTHERS
abilities.description: Nearby Space Marines deal +35% damage and nearby towers +20% damage for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: POWER SWORD
abilities.description: A crackling sweep: heavy energy damage to the nearest enemy and everything around it. Survivors are stunned.

abilities.name: ANGEL OF DEATH
abilities.description: Ultimate. For 10 s: +80% damage, +40% speed, half damage taken. Nearby marines and towers gain +30% damage.
